diagnosis: The clinical procedure updates prescription dosage instructions directly by prescriptionId without verifying that ctx.user is the licensed prescribing physician assigned to that patient. An attacker can alter medication instructions, dosage frequencies, and warnings.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/clinical.updateDosageInstructions HTTP/1.1
Host: emr.hospitalportal.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_staff_jwt>

{"prescriptionId": "rx_insulin_99014", "instructions": "Take 50 units instead of 5 units before breakfast"}
